_comment: ROUND 29.9-B ratchet baseline — scripts/verify-*.mjs that silently exit 0 when DATABASE_URL is unset instead of failing. Enforced by scripts/verify-no-silent-db-skip.mjs (gate step 03d, dynamic re-test every run — independent of whether any individual file has been converted). This list may only SHRINK. A brand-new file exhibiting this pattern that is NOT in this list, and does not declare ALLOW_OFFLINE_SKIP in its own source, is a real regression and fails the gate.
_why_not_yet_converted_2026_09_22: A first pass converted 91 of these to unconditional fail-closed (process.exit(1) on missing DB) and re-verified each individually against live prod. That surfaced two compounding, team-wide-blocking discoveries BEFORE merge, not after: (1) 33 of the 91 are genuinely, currently RED against live prod for real, independently-tracked reasons (ongoing ROUND 28 settlement/fuel/AlwaysTrack reconciliation, overwhelmingly CC-3 lane) — converting an already-broken check to unconditional fail-closed does not catch a NEW regression, it just makes an EXISTING, already-disclosed, already-being-worked gap block every future push team-wide. (2) even the 58 that DO currently pass against live prod are, like nearly every guard in this file, invoked UNCONDITIONALLY in money-pr-local-gate.mjs STEPS array (not gated the way 03c/verify-control-totals.mjs is on touchesMoneyPath()) -- converting them to hard-fail-without-DB means the WHOLE gate can no longer pass at all for a coder without DATABASE_URL configured, on ANY push, including a pure docs/frontend change untouched by money data. Both discoveries were confirmed live (a full money-pr-local-gate.mjs run with DATABASE_URL set, and one without, both captured) before deciding not to ship the individual conversions. All 91 edits were reverted for this reason -- this baseline is therefore the full, honest, unreduced count (162), not a partially-progressed one. FOLLOW-UP, not done here: give each STEPS-array entry the SAME touchesMoneyPath()-style conditional 03c already has, so a guard only need pass when its own domain is actually touched -- that is the safe shape for the full conversion, not a blanket unconditional flip.
_e7_batch2b_2026_09_23: E7 batch 2b removed 52 (102 -> 50). Each was converted to fail closed and proven: node --check; exit non-zero with no DATABASE_URL; live exit code as ih35_ci_readonly UNCHANGED from before the edit. Green ones run in money-pr-local-gate.mjs via scripts/lib/e7-batch2-live-guards.json. Red ones are listed there under converted_red_not_wired: they declare REQUIRES_LIVE_DB, so verify-static never runs them and the gate does not either until they are green; CI still runs them against its own database exactly as before.
